statement: The function returns a result r, and r = true if and only if there exist indices i, j, k with 0 <= i < j < k < len(nums) such that nums[i] < nums[j] < nums[k]. Equivalently, r = false if and only if no such indices i, j, k exist.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -2147483648 <= nums[i] <= 2147483647.

statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -2147483648 <= nums[i] <= 2147483647.

statement: For every slice other with len(other) = len(nums), every element of other in the range -2147483648..2147483647, and with nums[i] < nums[j] if and only if other[i] < other[j] for all 0 <= i < len(nums) and 0 <= j < len(nums), the function returns a result r when applied to nums and a result s when applied to other, and r = s.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 500000 and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -2147483648 <= nums[i] <= 2147483647.
